Resolves #20115

Eliminates redundant work and instance leaks across `Neo.grid.Row`, `Neo.grid.Container`, `Neo.grid.header.Wrapper`, `Neo.collection.Base`, and `examples/grid/bigData/` during 100k-row × 200-column dataset swaps, filtering, and 2D virtual scrolling.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline unit tests ran.

Evidence: L3 (Playwright unit + real-layout component + E2E suites covering collection, data, grid, and bigData hot paths) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-7).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/RowCellIdMigration.spec.mjs` (`Pass 2 is skipped when all columns are pooled and getLogicalCellId is lazy`) + existing permanent/locked cell migration specs |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/RowCellIdMigration.spec.mjs` (`Pass 2 is skipped when all columns are pooled and getLogicalCellId is lazy`) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/DynamicColumn.spec.mjs` (`Replacing grid.columns at runtime destroys old Column & Button instances and skips intermediate onColumnsMutate`) + `test/playwright/component/grid/ColumnId.spec.mjs` (`a runtime column swap that creates locked start and end regions measures and renders both locked bodies`) |
| AC-4 | `test/playwright/unit/collection/Base.spec.mjs` (`splice bypasses per-item isFilteredItem when no effective filters exist and evaluates when filtered`) |
| AC-5 | `test/playwright/unit/collection/Base.spec.mjs` (`Filter collection`, `Filter collection with undefined items`) |
| AC-6 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/DynamicColumn.spec.mjs` (`examples/grid/bigData GridContainer and MainStore update columns before store data and use clearSilent`) + `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderInlineProjectionNL.spec.mjs` (`Grid` arm loading `/examples/grid/bigData/index.html`) + `neomjs/benchmarks#4` (Post-Merge Validation) |
| AC-7 | `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/collection/ test/playwright/unit/data/ test/playwright/unit/grid/` (`654 passed`) + `test/playwright/component/grid/ColumnId.spec.mjs` (`2 passed`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Passed `oldValue` into `Container#createColumns(value, oldValue)` from `beforeSetColumns(value, oldValue)` because `Neo.createConfig`'s setter temporarily assigns `me._columns = value` before invoking `beforeSetColumns`, which previously caused `Neo.typeOf(me._columns) === 'NeoInstance'` to evaluate to `false` on runtime `grid.columns = ...` reassignments.
- Delegated the post-swap measurement and view-data refresh from `Container#createColumns` to `Container#afterSetColumns` (which `Neo.createConfig`'s equality check skips when `createColumns` returns the reused `existingCollection`), and destroyed `Column` instances alongside `this._columns` inside `GridContainer#destroy`.
- Unlinked retired `{componentId}` references via `VNodeUtil.unlinkRetiredReferences` on `toolbar.vnode`, `headerWrapper.vnode`, and `view.vnode` when destroying replaced `header.Button` instances, emptied locked toolbars, or emptied locked sub-grid bodies so parallel ancestor VDOM flights (`GridContainer#syncVnodeTree`) do not encounter stale component references before the child toolbar's VDOM update settles.
- Reset `me._count = 0` inside `Neo.collection.Base#clearSilent` so `collection.count` reflects the cleared state immediately before a subsequent `splice`.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] Run the `neomjs/benchmarks` `bigData` suite (`neomjs/benchmarks#4`) against the updated `grid` and `collection` hot paths.

Authored by Julia (Gemini 4 Argon, Antigravity). Session 0f43b37d-ee7f-4d12-b6ad-f5373f00e469.
